sourceData.meaningMnemonic: A <radical>horse</radical> that is <radical>fat</radical> is a <kanji>burdensome</kanji> animal.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: But you have to be nice to the <kanji>burdensome</kanji> horse because this horse is your <reading>da</reading>d (<ja>だ</ja>).
sourceData.meaningInfo: A fat horse. So burdensome. Not to mention the burden on the horse on top of the fatness.
sourceData.readingInfo: Go visit your dad the burdensome horse because you have to visit your dad. It's weird because you're a human and he's a horse.
